body:
## Council question

When during Storm does Bene Tleilax Infiltration resolve relative to revealing the storm distance and moving the storm?

The current Bene Tleilax sheet says "During Storm Phase". It does not give an exact window. The old phase guide puts Face Dancer activation before the storm dial or reveal, but describes the older mechanic. That ordering is evidence to check, not a ruling for the revised Infiltration ability.

Please specify the window for choosing and reviving an infiltrating leader, and whether an Infiltration arranged through Zoal on the previous turn resolves in that same window.

## Settled context

Norbert confirmed the normal turn order: Storm, Nexus, Spice Blow, CHOAM Charity, Bidding, Revival, Shipment and Movement, Battle, Spice Collection, Mentat. The phase is named Nexus, not Nexus check.

Initial storm placement is unchanged from GF9. Place the storm at a random sector on turn one; the GF9 procedure uses the two players beside the Storm Start sector dialing numbers from 0 to 20, revealing and adding them, then moving counterclockwise from Storm Start.

Quickstart v0.8 is the current starting point. Its Fate rule allows one exchange of Fate Indicators per faction during Mentat, provided neither participant has used its Fate. That timing is adopted from the chosen baseline and no longer awaits a separate confirmation. This is an editorial correction to the tracker, not a new council ruling.

## Worked timing case

Bene Tleilax has a matching Face Dancer card and an eligible enemy leader in the Tanks at the start of Storm. Must they commit to Infiltration before seeing this turn's storm distance, or may they wait until after the storm moves? If Zoal arranged an Infiltration in the previous Battle phase, when is that leader returned?

## Sources

Current [Bene Tleilax sheet](https://dune.zone/factions/bene-tleilax), Infiltration and Zoal; Quickstart v0.8; phase-guide.jpg; Norbert's confirmed turn order and baseline decisions on 4 October 2026.

Part of #1831. This issue stays open until the exact window is resolved. An answer of "I think so, but I need to verify" remains provisional.
title: Dreamrules ruling: When during Storm does Infiltration resolve?
